menu: RED EXODUS main menu: one sweeping Martian vista across the full human survival arc, from a tiny scorched Ark lander and red dust through first habitats, frontier domes and industry to a brine lake and green glass-domed city beneath blue sky; a lone spacesuited traveler surveys the future.
victory: Victory on New Earth: colonists celebrate outside a glass-domed city beside broad blue brine lakes and green terraces, a seedling raised into the first open-air dawn; rust ridges and the old Ark lander remain visible.
defeat: Defeat on Mars: colony lights fail beneath an advancing rust-brown dust storm, damaged habitat half-buried in red regolith, scattered solar panels; a survivor shelters one still-glowing cyan beacon, a stubborn last signal of hope.
